description: List invoices, optionally filtered by status and type.

status.description: Optional invoice status filter (case-insensitive, e.g. AUTHORISED).

type_.description: Optional invoice type filter (case-insensitive, e.g. ACCREC).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with an 'Invoices' list; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single invoice by its InvoiceID or InvoiceNumber.

invoice_id.description: The InvoiceID or InvoiceNumber of the invoice.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with an 'Invoices' list holding the invoice; on failure (not found), output contains a Xero error object.

description: Create a new invoice for a contact with optional line items.

contact_id.description: The ContactID the invoice is billed to.

line_items.description: Optional list of line item objects with Quantity and UnitAmount used to compute totals.

date.description: Optional invoice date in 'YYYY-MM-DD'; defaults to today.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with an 'Invoices' list holding the created invoice; on failure (contact not found), output contains a Xero error object.
A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a 'Contacts' list; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List all accounts from the chart of accounts.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with an 'Accounts' list; on failure, output contains an error message.
